audience: practice managers and admin staff of clinics that use the Healthie platform

useCases.title: List the practice's services
useCases.text: The AI lists the appointment types of the practice, with an optional keyword filter. You get a clear list of the services you offer.

useCases.title: Check practice details and account
useCases.text: The AI reads the organization (name, contact, user counts) and the account that owns the API key. Use it to confirm the right practice is connected.

useCases.title: List the practice's charting and intake form templates
useCases.text: The AI lists the custom form templates, such as charting notes and intake forms, by keyword or category. You see which templates the practice has.

useCases.title: Add an internal to-do for the team
useCases.text: The AI creates a task with the task text, due date and priority, for example to renew a supply order. The task is not tied to any client.
